summary: NEO Directive backend testing complete. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_neo_directive.py covering Stripe health/catalog, Reps/Managers CRUD, public rep resolver, trust-case creation with rep_code + referral snapshot, Stripe checkout guard + client checkout + payment status, commission engine (4 splits: solo/mgr x basic/private), commission approve/deny via admin API, WhatsApp APPROVE handler, and Nia chat (basic reply + history + 4 urgent-flag phrases). 22/22 tests passing.

minor.issue: FastAPI on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated — should migrate to lifespan handlers

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >6000 lines — split by domain (stripe/commissions/nia/reps/managers) into routers.

stripe_service.setup_catalog swallows all exceptions and returns {} silently on failure — the admin endpoint responds ok:true even when Stripe is misconfigured. Consider re-raising so /admin/stripe/setup-catalog surfaces a 502.
_stripe_apply_paid always sets case.status='Payment Verified' before the already_paid short-circuit — harmless idempotency but the update_case runs twice on webhook + status-poll.
resolve_rep_public is case-insensitive on input (upper()), which is correct; consider adding a rate limit since it's unauthenticated and enumerable.
Nia chat endpoint has no auth or rate-limiting; a public POST calls the LLM which costs $ per call. Add throttling by IP/session_id.

approval_code generation uses token_urlsafe(6).upper().replace(...) which can produce codes shorter than 6 chars if the sample contains many '_' or '-'. Use secrets.choice over a fixed alphabet instead.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral test reps (TESTREPxxxx, RESOLVxxxx, DELREPxxxx, CASExxxx, SPLxxxx), managers, and trust cases with TEST_ prefix in trust_name. Also creates commissions rows in db.commissions. These accumulate but are namespaced with random suffixes to avoid collisions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_neo_directive.py rebinds server.db to a fresh AsyncIOMotorClient inside asyncio.run() because the module-level motor client is bound to the ASGI event loop and can't be reused from pytest sync tests. If new endpoints touch the same helpers, reuse that _run() pattern. Nia LLM tests take ~5-10s each due to Claude call latency.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial test failures were test-harness issues (motor client bound to a different loop), fixed by rebinding server.db within a fresh event loop for the commission-engine tests.
